issue.title: [P2] Dense GEMV test suites still pin the launches the dense routes replaced in v34

fix_pr.title: [P2] Port dense-route tests while retaining GEMV precision coverage

corrections.scope: Test-only. The two suites move to the packed native window launch. No test function is deleted: FP8 13 to 13, BF16 25 to 25 (PR body).

red_receipt.source: tessera#611 body, master f587d5b62, image X

green_receipt_at_fix.result: 59 passed, 0 skipped, 40 tests allocated on the device
green_receipt_at_fix.note: The PR body names Torch 2.11.0+cu130 and no image. Image X carries Torch 2.13.0+cu130. The fix therefore had no green result on image X before this measurement.

elements.611.A: Decode regime: the module serves the packed native window GEMM. BF16 runs both dense lanes: the fused window kernel and the Triton window GEMM.
elements.611.B: Prefill keeps the same packed native path and materializes no weight.
elements.611.C: The serving module holds only the packed native bundle: no GEMV holder, no materialized planes, no wire bytes. Both residencies.
elements.611.D: Dispatch does not depend on the retired GEMV module: rung outside the GEMV range, rate-1 columns, compile identity, and a missing optional GEMV extension.
elements.611.E: A compiled forward with a dynamic token dimension serves M=1..8 and M=64 without a recompile.
elements.611.F: The retained GEMV reference coverage runs on a test-owned reference holder: precision, activation scale, host descriptor and CUDA graph capture.
